scope: Read-only source review of review.py, evidence.py and statistics_review.py against the frozen paired and repeated harnesses and inheritance driver; no phase evidence/statistics execution and no host access.

checks.raw_before_effects: Both complete workflows pass raw_workflow, counts/tables/logs/plan checks and raw-integrity.json is written before analyze; statistical opt-in is explicit.
checks.instruction_units: Exactly12 measured pairs plus2 warmup pairs,28 invocations/profiles per workload. Profiles independently require one events row and summary, resolve the Ir column, and join hashes/integers to JSON, JSONL and CSV.
checks.native_units: Exactly30 measured group pairs plus2 warmup pairs,8 repetitions per variant;512 total subruns. Nested/flat/CSV records, all additive sums, exact aggregate log bytes, command identities and no-compilation checks are enforced; inference remains30 pairs.
checks.statistics: Independent log-ratio bootstrap99%,20000 resamples seed1701, sign test excluding ties, AB/BA estimates and1% gates agree with the frozen formulas and all retained analysis/gate fields.
checks.prerequisites: Fixed fresh binary/source/build/correctness/CI/uv/seal/config identities join through transport and collected hashes; native requires accepted same-pair IR review, matching IR raw file hashes/status and exact native-prerequisite file set.
checks.input_integrity: Safe complete archive member set, copied controls and immutable record_files pre/post equality, terminal phase status, exact serial chronology, and final source/evidence rehash are checked for analyzed results.
checks.execution_status: Reviewer and statistical functions were not executed; root terminal-phase authorization remains required.
